snippet.title: [RF ONLINE NEXT] Woldview Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ruthless Steel Sci-Fi MMORPG, RF ONLINE NEXT
Meet the vast lore of RF Online Next.

▶ The discovery of Arcane. The Herodian invasion. A civilization on the brink.
▶ Planet Novus and the emergence of 3 factions (Bellato/Accretia/Cora).
▶ The Scion invasion and the endless galactic war.

In the vast space where 3 factions' fates overlap,
you will be at the center of it all.

👉Pre-register now: https://ntiny.link/RFONLINENEXT_sns_ww
